recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸的骨髓顆粒（particle）中，同一低倍視野就有四到五顆大型、細胞質豐富的巨核細胞，散在許多脂肪空泡與造血細胞之間；單一顆粒內巨核細胞數目明顯增加，就是巨核細胞增生的抹片表現。
features: Bone marrow particle with numerous fat vacuoles and densely packed hematopoietic cells
At least four to five large megakaryocytes within a single low-power field
Megakaryocytes with abundant granular cytoplasm and large lobulated nuclei obscured by thickness
Megakaryocytes dispersed rather than forming tight clusters
Thick particle area limits assessment of individual megakaryocyte morphology
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle with numerous fat vacuoles. At least four to five large megakaryocytes with abundant granular cytoplasm are present within a single low-power field, indicating increased megakaryocyte numbers. The megakaryocytes appear dispersed rather than tightly clustered, although the thickness of the particle limits evaluation of nuclear lobation and dysplasia. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic hyperplasia; correlation with platelet count, core biopsy morphology and, if thrombocytosis is present, MPN driver mutation testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: ET shows large hyperlobated staghorn megakaryocytes in loose clusters with persistent thrombocytosis and a JAK2, CALR or MPL mutation.
PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei in tight clusters, accompanied by reticulin fibrosis on biopsy.
In ITP megakaryocytes are increased but morphologically normal with peripheral thrombocytopenia.
Osteoclasts have multiple discrete round nuclei, and histiocytes are smaller with vacuolated cytoplasm.
